discussion:
An implementation of Media Access Control Security (MACsec) that fully conforms to its standard must implement at least the GCM-AES-128 cipher suite and may optionally implement the GCM-AES-256, GCM-AES-XPN-128 and GCM-AES-XPN-256 cipher suites, with 256-bit key sizes providing more bits of effective security. These cipher suites may be used to provide only data integrity (integrity-only mode) or both data integrity and data confidentiality (confidentiality protection mode).

Using a connectivity association lifetime of less than 24 hours (86400 seconds) and a secure association lifetime of less than four hours (14400 seconds) can provide a balance between security and usability.

The use of a Pre-Shared Key as a fallback authentication method if EAP-TLS authentication attempts fail can limit the effective strength of the EAP authentication.

For interoperability and maintainability reasons, the GCM-AES-128 and GCM-AES-XPN-128 cipher suites will not be approved beyond 2030.
title: A connectivity association lifetime of less than 24 hours (86400 seconds) is used for MACsec connections.
